context: A teacher frames a Meiji-era documentary clip
purpose: Discuss history on screen; teach それでは/明治/徹底/不明/援助/厚生/答弁/陣/書き込み

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: それでは、明治時代の特集を見ましょう。
lines.en: Now then, let us watch the Meiji-era feature.
lines.style: engaging teacher introducing the documentary, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 明治の改革って、すごい徹底ぶりですね。
lines.en: The Meiji reforms were astonishingly thorough.
lines.style: impressed teen reacting to the scale

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の記録には不明な点も多いんです。
lines.en: There are many unclear points in the records.
lines.style: careful teacher noting historical uncertainty, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 政府の援助で学校が増えたんですね。
lines.en: Schools increased thanks to government aid.
lines.style: curious teen connecting cause and effect

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、今の厚生政策の原型とも言えます。
lines.en: Yes, you could call it the model for today’s welfare policy.
lines.style: knowledgeable teacher drawing a long line

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 国会の答弁の記録も残ってるんですか？
lines.en: Do records of Diet replies survive too?
lines.style: inquisitive teen probing the archives, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 残っていますよ。報道陣もいなかった時代ですが。
lines.en: They do, though it was before any press corps.
lines.style: informative teacher contrasting the eras, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今ならネットの書き込みで大騒ぎですね。
lines.en: These days it would blow up in online posts.
lines.style: amused teen imagining a modern reaction
